## System Data

EV 5 needs 24.82 kilowatt-hours and is parked from 7:30 pm until a quarter to midnight on a 7 kilowatts charger. EV 6: arrives 02:45, leaves 6 am, 5669 Wh, 7 kilowatts maximum. EV 8 is there from 8:30 pm to midnight at the end of the day; give it 17.78 kilowatt-hours, and its plug tops out at 7 kilowatts. From 4:30 pm to 5:45 pm, EV 9 occupies a 7000 watts charger and requires 4.26 kilowatt-hours. EV 10: arrives 21:30, leaves midnight at the end of the day, 22.42 kWh, 7000 W maximum.

The lot can never pull more than 50 kW in total. The tariff is $0.12/kWh off-peak and $0.45/kWh from 16:00 to 21:00.

Give me the cheapest way to charge all of this. Tell me how many kWh are left undelivered at the end of the day, to two decimals.

EV 1: v0 v1 v2 ... v95
